title: Models library and installer disagree on where a dep lives

summary: Brief attached from brainstorm: findings, traps and open questions.
Reproducing the library-vs-installer path disagreement before any fix.

One resolver: _localModelsCheck delegates to resolveComfyPath, whose custom-root search is now scoped to the dep's own bucket. The brief's scenario did not reproduce - the divergence ran the other way (a same-named weight in another bucket read installed to the installer, not-installed to the library). tests/dep-path-agreement.test.cjs pins it; 774/774 suite green.
